How to play Sniper City

Sniper City is a last-one-alive sniper match. Eight snipers start on separate rooftops of one Hong Kong block. A match lasts about five minutes, and the safe area shrinks as it goes on.

The rules

  • Every shot leaves a thread. A red line hangs in the air and points back at whoever fired. Shoot, then move.
  • The angel is watching. Each time its halo tightens, it opens its arms. Break its line of sight or it will show you to everyone, even through walls.
  • Stay inside the halo. When the halo closes, anyone outside it bleeds.
  • Blood for blood. There are no medkits. Each elimination gives you back 30 health.
  • Do not fall. Launch pads, ziplines, ladders and alley jumps link the roofs. The street kills you.
  • Last one alive wins.

Solo matches open with a 10-second briefing that you can skip. Weapons unlock a few seconds after the match starts.

Phone and tablet controls

  • Left thumb moves on the fixed joystick. Right thumb looks.
  • Drag the fire button to aim and release to shoot.
  • The scope button toggles the scope. The run button locks sprint.
  • Tap a weapon slot to switch guns.
  • The bolt button opens a menu for the decoy, playing dead, the prayer and the RPG.
  • Open Controls to move, resize or hide any button, switch to a left-handed layout, or turn on gyro aiming.

Tips for new players

  • Move after every shot. The red thread gives your position away for several seconds.
  • Hold your breath before a long shot to steady the scope.
  • In solo matches rifle bullets take time to arrive and fall on the way. Aim ahead of a moving target, and use the 50, 100 and 150 metre marks under the crosshair for long shots.
  • A red glint means a sniper is aiming at you. Break line of sight.
  • Use the decoy to draw a shot, then follow the thread back to the shooter.
  • Playing dead can save you when someone is closing in. Moving gets you back up.
  • Watch the halo timer at the top of the screen and cross roofs early.

Solo and online

Solo matches put you against seven computer-controlled snipers, and you choose how skilled they are. To play online, choose Play online, make a room and share the code or link. Up to eight people can join. Dogs and Lucifer are in solo matches only. The RPG-7, the air drop, the prayer and scope vision also run online. When the air drop starts, a red diamond on your map points at the roof.
